<documents>
<document id="disputes-pending">
Whyˆcan'tˆIˆdisputeˆaˆpendingˆtransaction?ˆYouˆcan'tˆdisputeˆaˆtransactionˆwhileˆit'sˆstillˆpending.ˆAˆpendingˆtransactionˆisˆanˆauthorization.ˆTheˆmerchantˆhasn'tˆcollectedˆtheˆmoneyˆyet,ˆandˆtheˆamountˆcanˆstillˆchangeˆorˆdisappear.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆdoˆWaitˆforˆtheˆtransactionˆtoˆpost.ˆMostˆpendingˆtransactionsˆpostˆorˆdropˆoffˆwithinˆ7ˆdays.ˆOnceˆitˆposts,ˆtheˆDisputeˆoptionˆappearsˆwhenˆyouˆtapˆit.ˆ##ˆIfˆyouˆdon'tˆrecognizeˆitˆFreezeˆyourˆcardˆnow,ˆevenˆthoughˆyouˆcan'tˆdisputeˆyet.ˆThatˆstopsˆanyˆmoreˆcharges.ˆWhenˆtheˆtransactionˆposts,ˆdisputeˆitˆasˆunauthorized.ˆYourˆdisputeˆwindowˆstartsˆfromˆtheˆstatementˆitˆpostsˆon,ˆsoˆyouˆwon'tˆloseˆtimeˆbyˆwaiting.ˆ##ˆIfˆtheˆamountˆisˆwrongˆPendingˆamountsˆareˆoftenˆestimates,ˆforˆexampleˆatˆgasˆpumpsˆorˆhotels.ˆTheˆpostedˆamountˆisˆusuallyˆdifferent.ˆWaitˆandˆseeˆwhatˆposts.ˆ##ˆIfˆit'sˆbeenˆpendingˆaˆlongˆtimeˆSomeˆmerchantsˆtakeˆlonger.ˆIfˆaˆtransactionˆhasˆbeenˆpendingˆmuchˆlongerˆthanˆusual,ˆmessageˆsupportˆandˆwe'llˆlookˆatˆit.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="atm-cash-not-dispensed">
ATMˆdidn'tˆgiveˆmeˆmyˆcashˆIfˆanˆATMˆtookˆmoneyˆfromˆyourˆaccountˆbutˆdidn'tˆgiveˆyouˆtheˆcash,ˆorˆgaveˆyouˆlessˆthanˆyouˆaskedˆfor,ˆyouˆcanˆdisputeˆit.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆdoˆ1.ˆNoteˆtheˆATMˆlocation,ˆdateˆandˆtime,ˆandˆkeepˆanyˆreceipt.ˆ2.ˆCheckˆtheˆapp.ˆSometimesˆtheˆATMˆreversesˆtheˆwithdrawalˆonˆitsˆownˆwithinˆaˆfewˆdays,ˆandˆtheˆtransactionˆdisappearsˆorˆshowsˆaˆmatchingˆcredit.ˆ3.ˆIfˆit'sˆstillˆthereˆonceˆtheˆwithdrawalˆhasˆposted,ˆopenˆaˆdisputeˆinˆtheˆappˆwithinˆ60ˆdays.ˆTapˆtheˆtransaction,ˆthenˆGetˆhelp,ˆthenˆCashˆnotˆdispensed.ˆ##ˆWhatˆhappensˆnextˆWeˆaskˆtheˆATMˆoperatorˆforˆitsˆrecords.ˆMostˆATMˆcasesˆareˆresolvedˆwithinˆ10ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆIfˆtheˆrecordsˆshowˆtheˆcashˆwasn'tˆdispensed,ˆweˆcreditˆtheˆfullˆamount,ˆincludingˆanyˆATMˆfeeˆweˆchargedˆforˆthatˆwithdrawal.ˆ##ˆPendingˆwithdrawalsˆYouˆcan'tˆdisputeˆaˆwithdrawalˆwhileˆit'sˆstillˆpending.ˆWaitˆuntilˆitˆposts.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="disputes-how-to-file">
HowˆtoˆfileˆaˆdisputeˆMostˆdisputesˆcanˆbeˆfiledˆyourselfˆinˆtheˆappˆinˆaˆcoupleˆofˆminutes.ˆSupportˆcanˆalsoˆfileˆoneˆforˆyou.ˆ##ˆFileˆitˆyourselfˆ1.ˆTapˆtheˆtransactionˆinˆyourˆactivityˆfeed.ˆ2.ˆTapˆGetˆhelpˆandˆchooseˆtheˆreason.ˆ3.ˆAnswerˆtheˆquestionsˆandˆaddˆanyˆdocuments.ˆ##ˆBeforeˆyouˆfileˆ-ˆTheˆtransactionˆmustˆhaveˆposted.ˆPendingˆtransactionsˆcan'tˆbeˆdisputed.ˆ-ˆUnauthorizedˆtransactions:ˆwithinˆ60ˆdaysˆofˆtheˆstatementˆdate,ˆandˆtheˆcardˆmustˆbeˆfrozenˆorˆreportedˆfirst.ˆ-ˆMerchantˆproblems:ˆwithinˆ120ˆdaysˆofˆtheˆtransactionˆdate,ˆafterˆcontactingˆtheˆmerchant.ˆ##ˆFilingˆthroughˆsupportˆSupportˆcanˆopenˆdisputesˆtotalingˆupˆtoˆ$5,000ˆperˆcase.ˆLargerˆcasesˆgoˆtoˆourˆDisputesˆteam,ˆwhoˆwillˆcontactˆyouˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆOneˆdisputeˆperˆtransactionˆIfˆaˆtransactionˆalreadyˆhasˆanˆopenˆdispute,ˆaddˆinformationˆtoˆthatˆcaseˆinsteadˆofˆopeningˆaˆnewˆone.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
</documents>

Customer question: Can I dispute a transaction that's still pending?
